name: sample-lessons-learned
title: Sample lessons learned
description: Reads pasted project close-out notes and groups the lessons by theme, such as planning, data and handover, with one suggested action for each.
examplePrompt: Here are the close-out notes from our last project. Group the lessons by theme and suggest one action for each.

name: sample-meeting-actions
title: Sample meeting actions
description: Turns pasted meeting notes into a list of actions with owners and due dates, and flags risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies for a RAID log.
examplePrompt: Here are my notes from today's project call. List the actions with owners and due dates, then pull out anything for the RAID log.

name: sample-sql-explainer
title: Sample SQL explainer
description: Explains a SQL query or DAX measure in plain English, step by step, for a junior consultant, and points out likely mistakes.
examplePrompt: Explain this SQL query step by step for someone new to the team, and tell me if anything looks wrong.
